concurrency.definition: Overlap of observed launcher start/finish intervals for the remaining four cases, excluding their pre-CLI account-slot waits.
concurrency.qualification: Four case requests were dispatched concurrently; account_concurrency=1 delayed the first palace request. The account-slot correction does not imply four model processes actually overlapped in this run.

scope: Cloud execution, real tool evidence, delivery identity and static Host artifact verification only. No visual-quality or complete-navigability approval is inferred.

runtime.qualification: Later local source fixes and platform routing adaptations are not part of these frozen V3 cloud artifacts.

caseInputPolicy: Five fixed original references and effective user prompts. Palace replacement uses the same V3 runtime and original input hashes; only the task account concurrency changes from one to four after confirmed cancellation.

timingDefinitions.cloudProcessingSecondsExcludingQueue: Provider processing duration excluding the queue; includes account-slot wait before CLI launch.
timingDefinitions.cliLauncherWallSeconds: Observed launcher start-to-finish interval; includes real model/tool work and launcher packaging checks.
timingDefinitions.localDeliverySeconds: Local download phase as recorded by the coordinator.
timingDefinitions.simulationSeconds: Actual SDK fixed-tick simulation duration, distinct from wall time.

cliTokenUsageDefinition: Raw turn.completed usage from the full Codex stream. Repeated cached context can be counted many times; these are not unique prompt sizes or a price estimate.

palaceCancelledPreCliAttempt.reason: User requested four simultaneous cases; account_concurrency=1 can wait on the shared slot-zero semaphore. Retry only after terminal with four account slots, same original inputs and V3 runtime.

operatorVerificationCorrection.reason: The first Host verifier invocation supplied an unprefixed expected digest, while the verifier compares sha256:-prefixed identities. Re-running with the exact prefixed receipt digest passed; no archive or payload bytes were modified.
